Usage:
  phpcpd [options] <directory>

Options for selecting files:

  --suffix <suffix>            Include files with names ending in <suffix>
                               (default: .php; repeatable)
  --exclude <path>             Exclude files with <path> in their path
                               (repeatable)
  --preset <name>              Apply a framework preset (e.g. laravel): sets
                               sensible paths, suffixes, and excludes
  --triage                     Run Stage 0 corpus triage before detection (on by
                               default; this asks for it explicitly)
  --no-triage                  Skip Stage 0 entirely: no file is labelled
                               unwired, shadowed, vendored or derived
  --triage-posture <posture>   What triage does with a file it labels: discard
                               it from the scan (default), or label it and
                               nothing else
  --no-preset                  Do not auto-apply a framework preset when one is
                               detected (detection announces itself; --preset=
                               overrides it)
  --no-default-excludes        Scan generated and cache trees too (vendor,
                               node_modules, .phpstan.cache, build, ...), which
                               are skipped by default
  --allow-root-scan            Permit a scan root of / or a root above the
                               nearest composer.json (refused by default:
                               `phpcpd /` is almost always a typo for `phpcpd
                               ./`)

Orphan detection (dead code):

  --orphans                    Detect orphaned symbols (unreferenced classes,
                               interfaces, traits, enums, functions) instead of
                               clones
  --no-suppress <rules>        Turn off suppression rules by name,
                               comma-separated, or "all" (conditional, fixtures,
                               config, template, manifest, namespace, keep,
                               entrypoint, discovery, convention, planned)
  --fail-on <tiers>            Result tiers that make the run exit non-zero,
                               comma-separated (default: dead)
  --explain                    List every suppressed symbol and the rule that
                               suppressed it, instead of only counting them

Options for analysing files:

  --rk                         Rabin-Karp only (exact/Type-1 clones; faster, no
                               reorder detection). Default runs both Rabin-Karp
                               and TokenBag.
  --min-lines <N>              Minimum number of identical lines (default: 5)
  --min-tokens <N>             Minimum number of identical tokens (default: 100)

General options:

  --language <code>            Language for the report (default: en)

Options for analysing files:

  --verbose                    Print the duplicated code for each clone
  --raw                        Match raw text: identifiers must agree too (turns
                               off the default normalization)

Options for report generation:

  --min-confidence <log-odds>  List only findings the model scores at or above
                               <log-odds>; the rest are counted and readable
                               with --hidden, never dropped, and still gate
                               --fail-on
  --hidden                     List the findings --min-confidence held back
  --acknowledged <file>        Read a committed acknowledgment ledger from
                               <file>: listed duplication is demoted, never
                               hidden, and entries whose code changed expire and
                               are reported
  --write-acknowledged <file>  Write this run's findings to <file> as an
                               acknowledgment ledger, for review and commit
  --log-pmd <file>             Write log in PMD-CPD XML format to <file>
  --log-json <file>            Write log in JSON format to <file>
  --log-sarif <file>           Write log in SARIF 2.1.0 format to <file> (for
                               GitHub Code Scanning)

Options for CI integration:

  --cache                      Cache results in '.phpcpd-cache/' — a hit needs
                               every file unchanged, so it serves a re-run of
                               one commit rather than the next commit
  --cache-dir <path>           Read/write cache from <path> (implies --cache;
                               overrides default directory)
  --incremental                Per-file incremental index: re-tokenize only
                               changed files (rabin-karp or unified, not the
                               combined default; uses the cache directory)

General options:

  --config <file>              Read settings from <file> (default: ./phpcpd.ini
                               when present); keys are the long option names
  --show-config                Print the settings in force, where each came
                               from, and exit
  --no-config                  Ignore ./phpcpd.ini
  -h, --help                   Print this help
  -v, --version                Print version information
